messages:
anya (devex): Support case: new user runs `ri quickstart` after signup, CLI prints `402 Payment Required` and then the CLI retries for minutes. They never saw a billing prompt. What's the right behavior?

mike (sdk): can you paste the exact log lines? need to know if retry comes from http client or CLI wrapper.

anya (devex): user log:
```
2026-11-09T10:02:01Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
2026-11-09T10:02:01Z ri-cli WARN retrying request (1/5) after 1200ms
2026-11-09T10:02:02Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
```
They ran `ri account status` and saw `billing_state: pending` and no workspace.

ruchi (eng): 402 is not transient. CLI should not retry. Looks like a recent retry refactor introduced a generic check that lets 4xx through. Node/Go need parity with Python which treats 401/402 as terminal.

mike (sdk): plan: patch retry policy across SDKs to mark 401 and 402 non-retryable, update CLI to print an actionable message and exit non-zero. I'll open cross-repo issue and PRs.

anya (devex): Suggested CLI message: "Account blocked (402): complete billing to create a workspace. Run `ri billing add-card` or visit https://console.redwood.ai/settings/billing. Org: <org-id>. If you think this is a mistake, run `ri support escalate --org <org-id>`." Also prefer immediate exit so users don't wait.

mike (sdk): opened RD-6210 and PRs: node-sdk#1012, go-sdk#678. Adding integration test to simulate 402 and assert CLI exits quickly with help text.

ci-bot: node-sdk#1012 tests passed; go-sdk#678 awaiting CI.

ruchi (eng): I'll backport to the dedicated branch and add a metric to detect "4xx retries" spikes.

anya (devex): For the support case I asked user to run `ri account status` and share org_id + billing_state. If blocked or missing payment method, add card via console; if signup looked successful but no workspace, escalate to oncall with org id. I'll draft a KB with exact fields. :memo:
